subject: Request: Trial extension & sandbox top-up due to staging freeze
messages:
From: Rajiv Patel <rajiv@ledgerly.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Trial extension & sandbox top-up due to staging freeze

Hi Mina,

Quick note from our engineering lead — we hit a blocking regression in our staging environment after the recent connector upgrade. The team is paused while they work through a hotfix; we expect the work to take ~10 business days. That effectively stalls our pilot and demo timeline.

We still believe Redwood is the right fit and would like to continue the pilot, but we need two things to keep momentum: a short extension of the trial window and additional sandbox credits so our QA cycles can continue once the fix is deployed.

Specific ask: 2-week extension and 50k tokens of sandbox credit (we've been burning tokens on repeated end-to-end tests). I attached the staging error log and our current usage export.

Can you help escalate? We have a decision meeting with execs on Jun 25 and would like the runway secured before then.

Thanks,
Rajiv Patel
VP Product, Ledgerly Inc.
rajiv@ledgerly.com

Attachment: staging-error-log-20260610.txt
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Rajiv Patel <rajiv@ledgerly.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 15:03:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Trial extension & sandbox top-up due to staging freeze

Thanks for the context, Rajiv — sorry to hear about the regression. I’ve looped in Ben (AE) and Marissa (CS) to evaluate options on extension length and credits. Ben/Marissa: can you confirm what we can offer from a sales/CS standpoint? I’m attaching the usage export from our side to help the math.

We try to be consistent with extension policy but are flexible for cases like this where engineering work blocks progress. If you can send a short note from your engineering lead with an ETA on the hotfix, that helps approvals.

— Mina
Mina Haddad
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachment: trial-usage-20260610.csv
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 08:12:05 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: Trial extension & sandbox top-up due to staging freeze

Mina / Marissa — forwarding Ledgerly's ask. My proposed response: offer a 14-day extension + 50k sandbox tokens as a one-time make-good, subject to manager approval. I drafted a short proposal we can send to Rajiv and the engineering lead; attaching the draft.

If leadership wants to be more conservative we could do 10 days + 30k tokens instead. Let me know which lane to take.

Thanks,
Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Attachment: proposal-draft-ledgerly.pdf
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 08:45:14 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: Trial extension & sandbox top-up due to staging freeze

On Thu, Jun 11, 2026 at 08:12 AM Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com> wrote:
> Mina / Marissa — forwarding Ledgerly's ask. My proposed response: offer a 14-day extension + 50k sandbox tokens as a one-time make-good, subject to manager approval.

Thanks for the draft, Ben. I’m ok with a compromise: approve a 10-calendar-day extension and 30k tokens immediately so the customer can resume validation. If Ledgerly sends the engineering ETA and confirms the fix schedule, we can re-evaluate an additional credit bump after the fix is verified. Please make the approval message clear on re-evaluation criteria.

Marissa — please coordinate the credit allocation and note the change in the customer record. Ben/Mina — please send the customer-facing confirmation.

Rishi Malhotra
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Rajiv Patel <rajiv@ledgerly.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Anita Gomes <anita@ledgerly.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:38:07 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Trial extension & sandbox top-up due to staging freeze

Thanks, Ben / Rishi / Mina — appreciate the quick turnaround. 10 days and 30k tokens works for us as an immediate unblock. Anita (cc) will send the engineering ETA by end of day so you have the verification note.

We’ll accept that arrangement and will follow up with the fix confirmation once QA completes. Looking forward to getting back on track — thanks for helping keep the PoC alive.

Best,
Rajiv
VP Product, Ledgerly Inc.
rajiv@ledgerly.com
